attrs.remaining_trust: THE DOMAIN IS THE HONEST WEAKNESS AND IT IS NOT REPAIRABLE BY MORE ENUMERATION. Adequacy against a registered fault model says nothing about faults nobody registered, and SRC-DEMILLO-1978-MUTATION is explicit that mutation adequacy is a test-adequacy criterion rather than a correctness proof. SRC-BUDD-1982-EQUIVMUT is registered because this round EVADES its result rather than relies on it: equivalence is decidable here only because |P(K)| = 32, and a round that grows K or moves to an unbounded rule language inherits the undecidability and must go back to arguing. Four of the twelve mutants exist only because GPT-5.6 happened to name them; nothing generated them from the semantics.
attrs.rule: complete enumeration of a REGISTERED finite domain, which is not the domain of all faults
